readme: Provenance for excludes added by promote-verdicts.ps1. commodities.json is what the engine reads; this file records WHY each promoted rule exists, which weeks and items produced it, and is what you read before reverting one. A rule here was gated: it provably matched the dropped item and matched NO item the verify pass ever kept for that commodity.

killed_items: Kroger Rich N Honey Hot Dog Buns
rules.verdict_reason: Not honey. 'Kroger Rich N Honey Hot Dog Buns' is bread that matched on the word honey.

killed_items: Bomb Pop Extremes Super Sour Blue Raspberry Ice Pops
rules.verdict_reason: Not fruit. 'Bomb Pop Extremes Super Sour Blue Raspberry Ice Pops' is a freezer novelty that matched on 'raspberry'.

killed_items: Lance Variety Pack Sandwich Crackers, 40 pk.
rules.verdict_reason: 'Lance Variety Pack Sandwich Crackers' are filled cracker sandwiches (peanut butter/cheese), a different snack product than saltine/buttery crackers.

killed_items: Pace salsa, picante sauce or queso bowls, 11 to 22 oz., 2/ $5.00
rules.verdict_reason: Combined A-or-B-or-C ad line with a size range: 'Pace salsa, picante sauce or queso bowls, 11 to 22 oz., 2/ $5.00'. Two of the three products are not queso and the size spans 2x.

killed_items: Monster Energy Zero Sugar, Strawberry Shot, 16 fl. oz., 24 pk.
rules.verdict_reason: Monster Energy Zero Sugar Strawberry Shot is an energy drink, not fresh strawberries

killed_items: Ball Park Sesame Seed Burger Buns, 8 Count
rules.verdict_reason: Ball Park Sesame Seed Burger Buns, not sesame seeds

killed_items: Mission Sun-Dried Tomato Basil Wraps 6Ct
rules.verdict_reason: Mission Sun-Dried Tomato Basil tortilla Wraps, not sun-dried tomatoes

killed_items: Simple Truth Protein Black Pepper Lentils Brown Rice and Ancient Grains Whole Grain Blend
rules.verdict_reason: Not black pepper. 'Simple Truth Protein Black Pepper Lentils Brown Rice and Ancient Grains Whole Grain Blend' is a seasoned grain side dish; 'black pepper' is a flavour word in its name. It was crowning the spice at $0.34/oz.

killed_items: Hy-Vee Short Cuts pineapple chunks, FUEL SAVER EARN 5¢ OFF PER GALLON, $4.99 lb.
rules.verdict_reason: Fresh-cut produce, not canned. 'Hy-Vee Short Cuts pineapple chunks' is the refrigerated cut-fruit tub, and the captured line is a fuel-saver ad string quoting $4.99 lb.

killed_items: Hy-Vee ravioli or tortellini, 42 or 48 oz., $5.99
rules.verdict_reason: Combined A-or-B ad line with a size range: 'Hy-Vee ravioli or tortellini, 42 or 48 oz., $5.99'. Neither which product nor which size is determinable, so the per-ounce price is a coin flip.

killed_items: Stok Cold Brew Coffee Black Unsweetened 48 FL OZ
rules.verdict_reason: Liquid, not ground. 'Stok Cold Brew Coffee Black Unsweetened 48 FL OZ' is ready-to-drink cold brew; comparing its fluid ounces against ground coffee's dry ounces is why it read 66% under the runner-up.

killed_items: Happy Harvest French Green Beans 14 5 OZ
rules.verdict_reason: Canned, not fresh. 'Happy Harvest French Green Beans 14.5 OZ' is Aldi's canned-vegetable label; this commodity is fresh green beans priced per pound. It was 49% under the runner-up because a can of beans is not a pound of produce.

killed_items: La Costena Whole Jalapeno Peppers
rules.verdict_reason: Canned, not fresh. 'La Costena Whole Jalapeno Peppers' is the canned pepper; fresh jalapenos are the commodity here and pickled/canned ones already have their own row (pickled-jalapenos).

killed_items: Mama Cozzis Pesto Burrata 1815 OZ
rules.verdict_reason: Not pesto. 'Mama Cozzis Pesto Burrata' is a refrigerated pizza/burrata item, and its captured size (1815 OZ) is a mangled decimal we could not prove, so the per-ounce price is unsound as well.

rules.source: hand-picked over the scorer's brand bigram
killed_items: Kroger Strawberry Applesauce
rules.verdict_reason: Applesauce is never fresh fruit. Preferred over the auto-proposed \bkroger\s+strawberrys?\b, which would also have killed a legitimately named Kroger strawberry product.

rules.source: carrier-noun tightening (kept-set gate OVERRIDDEN on purpose)
killed_items: bakery/beverage/dressing carriers of the flavour word
rules.verdict_reason: This row's own word is a common FLAVOUR descriptor, so its include (e.g. \bhoney\b) matches biscuits, tea and spreads. Excluding one impostor only promotes the next: killing the hot dog buns handed the honey crown to Pillsbury Honey Butter Biscuits. The gate refused these patterns because those impostors were never DROPPED in a verdict - but not-dropped only means nobody judged them, it does not mean verified. Overridden deliberately: a biscuit is not honey, a hoagie roll is not sesame seeds, a vinaigrette is not sun-dried tomatoes.

rules.source: side-effect of the raspberries rule, caught by audit-match-soundness
killed_items: Bakery Fresh White Mini Cupcakes with Cherry and Blue Raspberry Buttercreme Icing
Mezzetta Mild Sweet Cherry Peppers
rules.verdict_reason: Excluding "blue raspberry" from raspberries pushed a cherry/raspberry CUPCAKE into cherries instead - the soundness guard caught the move and held the publish. Removing an impostor from one row can hand it to a neighbouring row; always re-run the guard after a rule change. Also caught Mezzetta Cherry Peppers sitting third on cherries.

killed_items: Seeds of Change Certified Organic Quinoa and Brown Rice with Garlic 8.5 oz., 6 pk.
rules.verdict_reason: Sam's brown-rice cell was a microwaveable organic quinoa/rice pouch 6-pack at $3.76/lb against ~$0.90-1.19/lb for dry rice everywhere else. guards.ps1 caught it as a 0.27x factor mismatch against its own link (Mahatma Brown Rice 5 lb, $0.996/lb) - the link was right and the BOARD row was the wrong product.

rules.pattern: coffee frappuccino / avocado cups / fabric conditioner / canned Allens green beans
rules.source: guards.ps1 factor-mismatch after the broader 25-per-term Sam's capture
killed_items: Starbucks Frappuccino Vanilla Coffee 9.5 fl oz 15 pk
GoVerden Perfectly Ripe Avocado 2 oz cups 16 ct
Snuggle SuperFresh Liquid FABRIC Conditioner
Allens Italian Style Green Beans 28 oz 6 pk
rules.verdict_reason: Capturing 25 candidates per term instead of 6 is the right call - it took Sam's from 1.2 to 22.5 priced rows per term and restored 339 board cells - but a broader net also surfaces more impostors, and the cheapest one wins. These four are the classic forms: a bottled coffee DRINK priced per fl oz against ground coffee per oz, avocado PULP cups on the whole-avocado row, FABRIC conditioner on the hair-conditioner row, and CANNED green beans on the fresh per-lb row. guards.ps1 caught every one as a board-vs-link factor mismatch.

killed_items: Member's Mark 4-Gallon Drawstring Trash Bags, 200 ct.
rules.verdict_reason: This commodity is the 13-GALLON tall kitchen bag. A 4-gallon bin liner is cheaper per bag because it is a smaller bag, not a better deal - it won the row at $0.067/bag against $0.133 for real kitchen bags. Excludes bag sizes 2-12 gallon; 13 gallon and "tall kitchen" are untouched.

killed_items: Starbucks Cold Brew Coffee Concentrates, Signature Black, 64 oz., 2 ct.
rules.verdict_reason: Third time this class hit the coffee row today: Aldi Stok cold brew (dropped in verify), a Starbucks Frappuccino bottle (excluded after a factor mismatch), and now a Starbucks cold brew CONCENTRATE crowning it at $0.218/oz. Liquid coffee is priced per FLUID ounce and ground coffee per WEIGHT ounce, so liquid always looks cheaper on this row. Every other store here is ground coffee, so both tokens are safe.
